about: Made-up postings for measuring Career's settled nightly scoring (docs/settled-scoring-measurement.md). They are scored against the made-up candidate of the kernel's ops/audit/career_scoring_agreement.py (Jordan Avery, a senior data engineer), whose 24 postings are reused as they are. No real person, employer posting or store is read. Tiers: A a clear fit, N designed near Career's 70 line (an adjacent role, or a must-have the candidate only partly meets), D a clear miss. Each entry is [tier, company, title, location, remote, description], the shape the kernel script uses.
postings: Build the pipelines that feed our finance and billing warehouse. Requirements: 6+ years of data engineering; expert Python and SQL; Airflow; dbt; AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift). You will own ingestion from payment processors, write data quality tests and partner with the controller's team. Nice to have: Spark, Terraform.

Modernize claims and policy data on AWS. Requirements: 5+ years building batch pipelines in Python and SQL; Spark on EMR or Glue; Airflow; Terraform for data infrastructure. Experience with regulated or claims data is a plus. On call one week in eight.

Run the dbt project, Airflow and Redshift that sixty analysts depend on. Requirements: 8+ years in data engineering; dbt in production; Airflow; Redshift tuning; a record of cutting warehouse cost; mentoring other engineers. Python for tooling.

Own the event pipelines behind live shipment tracking. Requirements: 6+ years of data engineering; Kinesis or Kafka in production; Spark Structured Streaming or Flink; Python; AWS. Logistics data experience is a plus.

Bring clinical and claims feeds into our governed warehouse. Requirements: 5+ years of ETL in Python and SQL; Airflow; Redshift or Snowflake; HIPAA-regulated data; infrastructure as code. You will document lineage and build data quality checks.

Lead three data engineers, hands-on most of the week. Requirements: 7+ years of data engineering; prior team leadership; Spark; Airflow; Python and SQL; AWS. You will set standards for testing and on-call.
Harden our data platform. Requirements: 6+ years; Python and SQL; Airflow; dbt with tests; AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift); Terraform. You will build data quality monitoring and reduce pipeline failures.

Build ridership and vehicle telemetry pipelines. Requirements: 5+ years of data engineering; Python; SQL; Airflow; AWS S3 and Redshift; streaming ingestion with Kinesis. Public-sector experience is not required.

Our stack is Azure: Data Factory, Databricks and Snowflake. Requirements: 5+ years of data engineering; production Azure Data Factory or Synapse; Snowflake; Python and SQL. AWS experience is transferable but all work is on Azure.

Manage a team of seven data engineers and hire two more. Requirements: 3+ years of people management of engineers, performance reviews and hiring; a background in data engineering on AWS; Spark and Airflow familiarity. Hands-on about 20 percent.

Build the APIs and services that serve our data products. Requirements: 6+ years of back-end engineering; Go strongly preferred, Python accepted; Kubernetes; PostgreSQL; some pipeline work with Airflow. Most of the work is service code, not pipelines.
Process ad events at 20 TB a day. Requirements: 5+ years of data engineering; Spark in Scala strongly preferred (Python teams exist); Kafka; AWS EMR; Hive or Iceberg tables.

Maintain the bank's warehouse. Requirements: 5+ years; Informatica PowerCenter and SQL Server Integration Services in production (required); T-SQL; Python a plus. A migration to AWS is planned for next year.
Build dbt models and Looker dashboards for merchandising. Requirements: 2+ years of dbt; SQL; Looker or another BI tool; working with business stakeholders. A mid-level, hands-on role.

Build pipelines for sequencing data. Requirements: 4+ years of data engineering in Python; Airflow or Nextflow; AWS; hands-on experience with genomics file formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF) is required. Relocation to Boston is required.

Build the platform our data scientists train and deploy on. Requirements: 5+ years in data or ML platform engineering; feature pipelines with Spark and Airflow; AWS SageMaker; deploying and monitoring models in production; Python.

Build Spark and Airflow pipelines for a federal civilian agency on AWS GovCloud. Requirements: 6+ years of data engineering; Python; AWS. US citizenship required; a Public Trust determination is sponsored after hire.

Own the enterprise data model and governance. Requirements: 10+ years in data, at least 3 as an architect; dimensional and Data Vault modeling; data governance programs; AWS data services. Mostly design and review, little hands-on pipeline work.
Provide preventive dental care. Requirements: an active Colorado dental hygiene license, local anesthesia certification, 2+ years of clinical experience.
Install and service commercial electrical systems. Requirements: a Colorado journeyman electrician license, 4+ years in the trade, conduit bending, reading blueprints.
Create characters for a console game. Requirements: 6+ years of character art in Maya and ZBrush, a portfolio of shipped titles, Substance Painter.
Support trial teams. Requirements: a paralegal certificate, 3+ years of litigation support, e-discovery platforms, court filing procedures.
Dispense medications and counsel patients. Requirements: a PharmD, an active Colorado pharmacist license, immunization certification.
Run job sites for commercial buildings. Requirements: 8+ years of construction supervision, OSHA 30, scheduling subcontractors, reading structural drawings.
Lead the pastry program of a hotel. Requirements: 7+ years in professional pastry kitchens, menu development, managing a team of six, food safety certification.
Fly regional jet routes. Requirements: an Airline Transport Pilot certificate, a first-class medical certificate, 1,500 flight hours, a type rating or willingness to obtain one.
